sources.title: Natural Earth Admin 0 - Countries 1:10m (Africa)
sources.source_institution: Natural Earth (Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and contributors)
sources.version: v5.1.2 (file identical to tag v5.1.2; repository commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19; VERSION file reads 5.2.0-pre)
sources.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth LICENSE.md: "Everything here is public domain.")
sources.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com. (Credit is optional per the source: "No permission is needed to use Natural Earth. Crediting the authors is unnecessary.")
sources.geographic_coverage: 54 African UN member states, plus Somaliland and Western Sahara as separate units as drawn by Natural Earth
sources.resolution: 1:10m source; simplified, tolerance 0.005 deg, max displacement 0.007244 deg (~0.8 km)
sources.limitations: Natural Earth shows de facto boundaries at cartographic scale and states that the authors are not responsible for accuracy; not a legal or cadastral boundary. Somaliland (NE code SOL) and Western Sahara (NE code SAH) are separate units in the source; they are kept as published with iso3 null and are not attributed to any of the 54 countries. Source files date from 2022 (release v5.1.2): later administrative reforms are not reflected.
transformations: kept features whose ISO_A3_EH is one of the 54 African UN member states, plus ADM0_A3 SOL and SAH
kept properties ISO_A3_EH (as iso3), ADM0_A3, NAME, NAME_LONG, NAME_EN, NAME_FR, TYPE
shapely 2.2 / GEOS 3.14 coverage_simplify (topology preserving, shared borders stay identical), tolerance 0.005 degrees

sources.title: Natural Earth Admin 1 - States, Provinces 1:10m (Africa)
sources.source_institution: Natural Earth (Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and contributors)
sources.version: v5.1.2 (file identical to tag v5.1.2; repository commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19)
sources.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth LICENSE.md: "Everything here is public domain.")
sources.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com. (Credit is optional per the source: "No permission is needed to use Natural Earth. Crediting the authors is unnecessary.")
sources.geographic_coverage: First-level administrative units of the 54 African UN member states (South Sudan: NE code SDS mapped to ISO SSD), plus Somaliland and Western Sahara units
sources.resolution: 1:10m source; simplified, tolerance 0.005 deg, max displacement 0.007244 deg (~0.8 km)
sources.limitations: Natural Earth shows de facto boundaries at cartographic scale and states that the authors are not responsible for accuracy; not a legal or cadastral boundary. Somaliland (NE code SOL) and Western Sahara (NE code SAH) are separate units in the source; they are kept as published with iso3 null and are not attributed to any of the 54 countries. Source files date from 2022 (release v5.1.2): later administrative reforms are not reflected. Admin 1 names and units follow Natural Earth, which may differ from current national gazetteers; for example Kenya appears as its 8 former provinces, not its 47 counties. Check against the national statistics office before operational use.
transformations: kept features whose adm0_a3 (SDS mapped to SSD) is one of the 54 countries, plus SOL and SAH
kept properties adm0_a3, admin, adm1_code, iso_3166_2, name, name_fr, type_en, type; added iso3
coverage_simplify tolerance 0.005 degrees (same method as admin 0)

sources.title: Natural Earth Populated Places 1:10m (Africa)
sources.source_institution: Natural Earth (Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and contributors)
sources.version: v5.1.2 (file identical to tag v5.1.2; repository commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19)
sources.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth LICENSE.md: "Everything here is public domain.")
sources.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com. (Credit is optional per the source: "No permission is needed to use Natural Earth. Crediting the authors is unnecessary.")
sources.geographic_coverage: 1285 populated places in the 54 African UN member states selected for 1:10m cartography
sources.resolution: Point locations at 1:10m cartographic scale (coordinates as published)
sources.limitations: pop_max, pop_min and pop_other are population estimates as published by Natural Earth, not census counts, and no reference year is given per feature. Only places selected for small-scale cartography are included: most villages relevant to mini grids are absent, so this is not a settlement inventory. Places in Somaliland and Western Sahara (NE codes SOL, SAH) are excluded.
transformations: kept features whose adm0_a3 (SDS mapped to SSD) is one of the 54 countries
kept properties name, nameascii, namealt, featurecla, adm0name, adm0_a3, adm1name, adm0cap, worldcity, megacity, pop_max, pop_min, pop_other, latitude, longitude, ne_id; added iso3

sources.title: Our World in Data energy data (Africa, electricity indicators)
sources.source_institution: Our World in Data (Global Change Data Lab), compiling Ember and Energy Institute data
sources.source_title: Data on Energy by Our World in Data, legacy release (owid-energy-data.csv, owid-energy-codebook.csv)
sources.version: repository commit f8de88a4f6f9cab44f1cf606047cbd6c4414042c; owid-energy-data.csv last changed in commit e7897aed55b514b8d16e0a3d8f1518789ac3de31 (2026-04-27)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 for data produced by Our World in Data; third-party data keep the licence of their original authors (repository README)
sources.attribution: Our World in Data, Data on Energy (github.com/owid/energy-data, commit f8de88a), based on Ember - Yearly Electricity Data (2026), Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2025) and OWID population (2024). The README asks users to cite both Our World in Data and the underlying data source(s).
sources.readme_licence_text: All visualizations, data, and code produced by Our World in Data are completely open access under the Creative Commons BY license. You have the permission to use, distribute, and reproduce these in any medium, provided the source and authors are credited. The data produced by third parties and made available by Our World in Data is subject to the license terms from the original third-party authors. We will always indicate the original source of the data in our database, and you should always check the license of any such third-party data before use.
sources.geographic_coverage: 54 African UN member states, national level
sources.limitations: The repository README states this legacy release 'is no longer updated' (a new methodology release exists on catalog.ourworldindata.org, which was not reachable from the build environment). Values are compiled by OWID from Ember and the Energy Institute; the licences of those third-party sources were not verified here. Latest available year differs by country and indicator.
transformations: kept rows whose iso_code is one of the 54 countries and that have at least one value in the kept columns
kept columns country, year, iso_code, electricity_generation, per_capita_electricity, renewables_share_elec, solar_share_elec, fossil_share_elec, electricity_demand, electricity_demand_per_capita
cell values copied verbatim (no rounding, no gap filling)
codebook rows for the kept columns copied verbatim

sources.title: Access to electricity (% of population), WDI EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS (Africa)
sources.source_institution: World Bank, World Development Indicators (copy maintained by the Datahub 'datasets' GitHub organisation)
sources.licence: CC-BY-4.0 (as stated in the mirror's datapackage.json)
sources.attribution: World Bank, World Development Indicators: Access to electricity (% of population), EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS. Licence CC BY 4.0. Retrieved via github.com/datasets/world-development-indicators (commit 4ebec5a).
sources.provenance: The mirror's scripts/get.py downloads https://api.worldbank.org/v2/en/indicator/<code>?downloadformat=csv and the indicator metadata from https://api.worldbank.org/v2/indicator/<code>; a monthly GitHub Action (.github/workflows/update.yml) runs scripts/extractFeaturedWorldBankDatasets.py and commits changes.
sources.geographic_coverage: 54 African UN member states, national level
sources.limitations: Secondary copy: the World Bank API (api.worldbank.org) was not reachable from the build environment, so values were not checked against the publisher. The World Bank's own source notes and methodology fields were not retrieved; the mirror's description reads: 'Electrification data are collected from industry, national surveys and international sources.' Values carry float precision artefacts as published (for example 99.1536560058594).
transformations: kept rows whose Country Code is one of the 54 countries
